const (
	AccessRead  Access = "read"
	AccessWrite Access = "write"
)

const (
	AlwaysPresent ContextLayer = "always_present"
	OnDemand      ContextLayer = "on_demand"
	RuntimeInject ContextLayer = "runtime_inject"
	MemoryLayer   ContextLayer = "memory"
)

const (
	CompressWindow      CompressionKind = "window"
	CompressSummary     CompressionKind = "summary"
	CompressToolResult  CompressionKind = "tool_result"
	CompressExternalize CompressionKind = "externalize"
	CompressPriority    CompressionKind = "priority"
)

const (
	Disposable Priority = iota
	Low
	Normal
	High
	Critical
)

const (
	EffectRead    EffectKind = "read"
	EffectWrite   EffectKind = "write"
	EffectExecute EffectKind = "execute"
	EffectNetwork EffectKind = "network"
	EffectUnknown EffectKind = "unknown"
)

const (
	EventRunStarted     EventKind = "run_started"
	EventTextDelta      EventKind = "text_delta"
	EventReasoningDelta EventKind = "reasoning_delta"
	EventContentBlock   EventKind = "content_block"

	EventMessageCommitted EventKind = "message_committed"
	EventToolStarted      EventKind = "tool_started"
	EventToolCompleted    EventKind = "tool_completed"
	EventUsage            EventKind = "usage"
	EventRunCompleted     EventKind = "run_completed"
	EventRunFailed        EventKind = "run_failed"
)

const (
	FromStart SelectorKind = "from_start"
	ToEnd     SelectorKind = "to_end"
	ByIndex   SelectorKind = "by_index"
	ByID      SelectorKind = "by_id"
)

const (
	IngestKeep   IngestKind = "keep"
	IngestSkip   IngestKind = "skip"
	IngestModify IngestKind = "modify"
)

const (
	InjectSystem  InjectionKind = "system"
	InjectSkill   InjectionKind = "skill"
	InjectMessage InjectionKind = "message"
	InjectRuntime InjectionKind = "runtime"
	InjectMemory  InjectionKind = "memory"
)

const (
	OutcomeSucceeded OutcomeStatus = "succeeded"
	OutcomeFailed    OutcomeStatus = "failed"
	OutcomeCancelled OutcomeStatus = "cancelled"
)

const (
	Parallel     ExecutionMode = "parallel"
	SerialGlobal ExecutionMode = "serial_global"
	Coordinator  ExecutionMode = "coordinator"
)

const (
	RecordConversation RecordKind = "conversation"
	RecordModelIntent  RecordKind = "model_intent"
	RecordModelOutcome RecordKind = "model_outcome"
	RecordToolIntent   RecordKind = "tool_intent"
	RecordToolOutcome  RecordKind = "tool_outcome"
	RecordExtension    RecordKind = "extension"
)

func (err *SessionError) Error() string

func (err *SessionError) Unwrap() error

func (err *ToolBlockedError) Error() string

func (r SessionRecord) Validate() error

func (registry *ToolRegistry) Get(name string) (Tool, bool)

func (registry *ToolRegistry) Register(tool Tool) error

func (registry *ToolRegistry) Remove(name string) bool

func (registry *ToolRegistry) Replace(tool Tool) (Tool, error)

func (registry *ToolRegistry) Snapshot() ToolRegistrySnapshot

func (scheduling Scheduling) Validate() error

func (state *AgentState) Extensions() *Extensions

func (state *AgentState) Model() LanguageModel

func (state *AgentState) Session() ConversationLog

func (state *AgentState) SetModel(model LanguageModel) error

func (state *AgentState) SetSession(session ConversationLog) error

func (state *AgentState) Tools() *ToolRegistry

func BuiltinRecord(record SessionRecord) SessionRecord

func CloneEvent(event Event) Event

func CloneRecords(records []SessionRecord) []SessionRecord

func DeleteExtension[T any](extensions *Extensions)

func GetExtension[T any](extensions *Extensions) (T, bool)

func NewAgentState(model LanguageModel, session ConversationLog, tools []Tool) (*AgentState, error)

func NewExtensions() *Extensions

func NewToolRegistry(tools []Tool) (*ToolRegistry, error)

func NormalizeResource(resource, workspace string) string

func OnlyCancellation(err error) bool

func PutExtension[T any](extensions *Extensions, value T)

func SchedulingConflicts(left, right Scheduling, workspace string) bool

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/kernel/bus"
	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/llm/wire"
)

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/llm/wire"
	"time"
)

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/kernel/bus"
	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/llm/wire"
	"reflect"
	"sync"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/llm/wire"
)

import (
	"errors"
	"path"
	"strings"
)

import (
	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/llm/wire"
)

type Access string

type AfterModelHook interface {
	AfterModel(context.Context, RuntimeContext, *wire.Message) error
}

type AfterToolHook interface {
	AfterTool(context.Context, ToolExecutionContext, wire.ToolCall, *wire.ToolResult) error
}

type AgentState struct {
}

type BeforeModelHook interface {
	BeforeModel(context.Context, RuntimeContext, *ModelRequest) error
}

type BeforeToolHook interface {
	BeforeTool(context.Context, ToolExecutionContext, wire.ToolCall) error
}

type BudgetInfo struct {
	ModelWindow, BudgetTokens, UsedTokens, RemainingTokens int
	UsageRatio                                             float64
}

type CompressAction struct {
	Kind                     CompressionKind
	KeepRecent               int
	Range                    MessageRange
	Hints                    []string
	MessageID, Summary, Path string
	Priority                 Priority
}

type CompressionKind string

type ContextAfterTurnHook interface {
	AfterTurn(context.Context, ContextHandle, string) error
}

type ContextApply interface {
	ApplyInjections(context.Context, []Injection, *[]string, *[]wire.Message) error
	ApplyCompressions(context.Context, []CompressAction, *[]wire.Message, ContextHandle, string) error
}

type ContextAssembleHook interface {
	Assemble(context.Context, ContextHandle, string, []ContextEntry, int) ([]ContextEntry, error)
}

type ContextBootstrapHook interface {
	Bootstrap(context.Context, ContextHandle, string) error
}

type ContextBudgetHook interface {
	OnBudgetExceeded(context.Context, ContextHandle, string, ContextSnapshot) ([]CompressAction, error)
}

type ContextDisposeHook interface{ Dispose(context.Context) error }

type ContextEntry struct {
	ID       string
	Message  wire.Message
	Metadata ContextMetadata
}

type ContextHandle interface {
	Snapshot(string) ContextSnapshot
	Budget(string) BudgetInfo
	Entries(string) []ContextEntry
	ReadMessage(string, string) (ContextEntry, bool)
	InjectMessage(string, ContextLayer, wire.Message) error
	TagPriority(string, string, Priority) error
	TagExclude(string, string) error
	AdvanceTurn(string)
}

type ContextHooks interface{ Name() string }

type ContextIngestHook interface {
	Ingest(context.Context, ContextHandle, string, ContextEntry) (IngestAction, error)
}

type ContextLayer string

type ContextMessageHook interface {
	OnMessage(context.Context, ContextHandle, string, wire.Message) ([]Injection, error)
}

type ContextMetadata struct {
	Layer                                                     ContextLayer
	Priority                                                  Priority
	EstimatedTokens                                           int
	Compacted                                                 bool
	ExternalizedPath, ReplacementSummary, SourceAgent, Origin string
	CreatedAt                                                 time.Time
	CreatedAtTurn                                             uint64
	Excluded                                                  bool
}

type ContextSnapshot struct {
	TotalTokens, BudgetTokens, ModelWindow int
	UsageRatio                             float64
	Layers                                 map[ContextLayer]LayerStats
	Entries                                []EntrySnapshot
	ToolPatterns                           []ToolPattern
}

type ContextSource interface {
	Load(context.Context, ConversationReader) ([]wire.Message, error)
}

type ContextSystem struct {
	Hooks        ContextHooks
	Handle       ContextHandle
	Apply        ContextApply
	Counter      TokenCounter
	BudgetTokens int
}

type ConversationLog interface {
	ConversationReader
	AppendRecords(context.Context, []SessionRecord) ([]SessionRecord, error)
	Flush(context.Context) error
}

type ConversationReader interface {
	ID() string
	Messages(context.Context) ([]wire.Message, error)
}

type Effect struct {
	Kind        EffectKind
	Description string
	Resources   []ResourceClaim
}

type EffectKind string

type EntrySnapshot struct {
	ID              string
	Layer           ContextLayer
	Priority        Priority
	EstimatedTokens int
	Origin          string
	AgeTurns        uint64
	Preview         string
}

type Event struct {
	Kind         EventKind          `json:"kind"`
	Text         string             `json:"text,omitempty"`
	ContentBlock *wire.ContentBlock `json:"content_block,omitempty"`
	Message      *wire.Message      `json:"message,omitempty"`
	ToolCall     *wire.ToolCall     `json:"tool_call,omitempty"`
	ToolResult   *wire.ToolResult   `json:"tool_result,omitempty"`
	Record       *RecordReference   `json:"record,omitempty"`
	Usage        *wire.Usage        `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	Error        string             `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type EventKind string

type EventSink interface {
	Emit(context.Context, Event) error
}

type ExecutionMode string

type Extensions struct {
}

type IngestAction struct {
	Kind     IngestKind
	Message  *wire.Message
	Priority *Priority
}

type IngestKind string

type Injection struct {
	Kind            InjectionKind
	Layer           ContextLayer
	Priority        Priority
	Section         *PromptSection
	SkillName, Text string
	Message         *wire.Message
	Memory          []MemoryFact
}

type InjectionKind string

type InputCommittedHook interface {
	InputCommitted(context.Context, RuntimeContext, wire.Message) error
}

type LanguageModel interface {
	Stream(context.Context, ModelRequest, func(wire.StreamChunk) error) error
}

type LayerStats struct {
	Tokens, Entries int
	Percentage      float64
}

type MemoryFact struct {
	ID, Text, Fingerprint, Category, SourceSession string
	Confidence                                     float64
	CreatedAt, LastAccessedAt                      time.Time
	AccessCount                                    uint64
}

type MessageRange struct{ From, To MessageSelector }

type MessageSelector struct {
	Kind  SelectorKind
	Index int
	ID    string
}

type Middleware interface{ Name() string }

type ModelAdmissionHook interface {
	AdmitModel(context.Context, RuntimeContext, ModelRequest) error
}

type ModelFunc func(context.Context, RuntimeContext, ModelRequest, func(wire.StreamChunk) error) error

type ModelIdentity interface {
	ProviderID() string
	ModelID() string
}

type ModelIntent struct {
	RequestID string `json:"request_id"`
}

type ModelOutcome struct {
	RequestID string        `json:"request_id"`
	Status    OutcomeStatus `json:"status"`
	Error     string        `json:"error,omitempty"`
	Usage     *wire.Usage   `json:"usage,omitempty"`
}

type ModelRequest struct {
	Messages []wire.Message
	Tools    []wire.ToolDefinition
	Config   wire.ModelConfig
}

type ModelWrapper interface {
	WrapModel(context.Context, RuntimeContext, ModelRequest, func(wire.StreamChunk) error, ModelFunc) error
}

type OutcomeStatus string

type PersistentSession interface {
	ConversationLog
	SessionStore
}

type PrepareToolHook interface {
	PrepareTool(context.Context, ToolPreparationContext, wire.ToolCall) (ToolPreparation, error)
}

type Priority int

type PromptSection struct {
	ID, Content string
	Priority    Priority
}

type RecordKind string

type RecordReference struct {
	SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
	RecordID  string `json:"record_id"`
	Sequence  uint64 `json:"sequence"`
}

type ResourceClaim struct {
	Resource string
	Access   Access
}

type RunEndHook interface {
	OnRunEnd(context.Context, RuntimeContext, error) error
}

type RunStartHook interface {
	OnRunStart(context.Context, RuntimeContext) error
}

type RuntimeContext struct {
	InvocationModel LanguageModel

	InvocationSessionID string
	RunID               string
	State               *AgentState
	Workspace           string
	Capabilities        bus.Handle
}

type Scheduling struct {
	ConcurrentSafe    bool
	Resources         []ResourceClaim
	ExecutionMode     ExecutionMode
	ManagesOwnTimeout bool
}

type SelectorKind string

type SessionError struct {
	Operation string
	SessionID string
	Err       error
}

type SessionRecord struct {
	Sequence      uint64           `json:"sequence"`
	ID            string           `json:"id"`
	Time          time.Time        `json:"time"`
	Namespace     string           `json:"namespace"`
	Type          string           `json:"type"`
	SchemaVersion uint32           `json:"schema_version"`
	Parent        *RecordReference `json:"parent,omitempty"`
	Kind          RecordKind       `json:"kind"`
	Payload       json.RawMessage  `json:"payload,omitempty"`
	Message       *wire.Message    `json:"message,omitempty"`
	ModelIntent   *ModelIntent     `json:"model_intent,omitempty"`
	ModelOutcome  *ModelOutcome    `json:"model_outcome,omitempty"`
	ToolIntent    *ToolIntent      `json:"tool_intent,omitempty"`
	ToolOutcome   *ToolOutcome     `json:"tool_outcome,omitempty"`
}

type SessionStore interface {
	Records(context.Context, uint64) ([]SessionRecord, error)
}

type TokenCounter interface {
	CountTokens(string) int
	ContextWindow() int
}

type Tool interface {
	Name() string
	Description() string
	ParametersSchema() json.RawMessage
	Execute(context.Context, ToolExecutionContext, wire.ToolCall) (wire.ToolResult, error)
	Scheduling(wire.ToolCall) Scheduling
	DescribeEffect(wire.ToolCall) Effect
	IsReadOnly(wire.ToolCall) bool
}

type ToolBlockedError struct{ Reason string }

type ToolExecutionContext struct {
	SessionID    string
	RunID        string
	CallID       string
	Workspace    string
	Progress     EventSink
	Capabilities bus.Handle
	Scheduling   Scheduling
	Session      ConversationLog

	ActualTool Tool
}

type ToolFunc func(context.Context, ToolExecutionContext, wire.ToolCall) (wire.ToolResult, error)

type ToolIntent struct {
	RunID string        `json:"run_id"`
	Call  wire.ToolCall `json:"call"`

	DeclaredCall *wire.ToolCall `json:"declared_call,omitempty"`

	NoSideEffect bool       `json:"no_side_effect,omitempty"`
	Effect       Effect     `json:"effect"`
	Scheduling   Scheduling `json:"scheduling"`
	ReadOnly     bool       `json:"read_only"`
}

type ToolOutcome struct {
	RunID  string          `json:"run_id"`
	CallID string          `json:"call_id"`
	Status OutcomeStatus   `json:"status"`
	Result wire.ToolResult `json:"result"`
	Error  string          `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type ToolPattern struct {
	ToolName                                          string
	CallCount, AverageResultTokens, TotalResultTokens int
}

type ToolPreparation struct {
	Arguments json.RawMessage
	Result    *wire.ToolResult
}

type ToolPreparationContext struct {
	Runtime    RuntimeContext
	ActualTool Tool
}

type ToolRegistry struct {
}

type ToolRegistrySnapshot struct {
	Version     uint64
	Tools       []Tool
	Definitions []wire.ToolDefinition
}

type ToolWrapper interface {
	WrapTool(context.Context, ToolExecutionContext, wire.ToolCall, ToolFunc) (wire.ToolResult, error)
}
